changelog.name: LocationMax 0.0.53
changelog.body:
# LocationMax 0.0.53

## 中文

**最好的定位模块**

- 高德地图与 OpenStreetMap，支持地点搜索、收藏和快速选点。
- 道路规划、跑道识别、手绘路线与闭合绕圈，支持速度调整、暂停和循环。
- 自动基站模拟随位置更新，支持中国广电等运营商。
- WGS-84、GCJ-02、BD-09 多坐标系可选。
- 支持运行中切换地点，优化界面操作及应用、小程序定位兼容性。

Android 11+，模块功能需要 Root 和兼容现代 Xposed API 101 的框架。兼容效果因系统与应用版本而异，跑道识别受地图资料影响。免费授权码请到 [Telegram 群组](https://t.me/gegewu678) 领取。

## English

**The best location module**

- AMap and OpenStreetMap, with place search, favorites and quick point selection.
- Road planning, track recognition, freehand routes and closed loops, with speed, pause and repeat controls.
- Automatic cell simulation follows the selected location, with China Broadnet and other carrier options.
- WGS-84, GCJ-02 and BD-09 coordinate systems.
- Location switching while running, with improved navigation and location compatibility for apps and mini-programs.

Android 11+ is required. Module features need root and a framework compatible with modern Xposed API 101. Compatibility varies by system and app version; track recognition depends on map data. Get the free activation code from the [Telegram group](https://t.me/gegewu678).

# LocationMax

> The best location module

**English** | [简体中文](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.huaMax/blob/main/README_CN.md)

Android location simulation for common apps and mini-programs, with map selection, route simulation and automatic cell simulation.

## Features

- **Maps and place search:** AMap and OpenStreetMap support, direct place search, saved favorites and quick location switching.
- **Change locations while running:** Search or select a new point without stopping the simulation first.
- **Roads and running tracks:** Road planning, running-track recognition, freehand routes and closed loops, with speed, pause, resume and repeat controls. Track recognition depends on map coverage and a clear view.
- **Automatic cell simulation:** Simulated serving cells, neighboring cells and carrier information follow the selected location. Supports China Mobile, China Unicom, China Telecom and China Broadnet.
- **Coordinate systems:** WGS-84, GCJ-02 and BD-09 input and display options.
- **Flexible location settings:** Target-app and system modes, with configurable accuracy, altitude, speed and random offsets.
- **A map-first interface:** Common actions in the bottom panel, direct search and step-by-step back navigation.

## Requirements and download

Module features require Android 11+, root and an LSPosed/Xposed framework supporting modern Xposed API 101. Compatibility varies by system, framework and app version.

Free to use. Get the monthly activation code from the community group when prompted. Activation requires an internet connection.
